name: argus-desktop-page
description: The desktop window's page: TypeScript compiled into ../assets/js, which is committed so building the crate needs no Node.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('../assets/js', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p . && esbuild src/vendor/codemirror.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=none --target=es2022 --outfile=../assets/js/vendor/codemirror.js --allow-overwrite --log-level=warning && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('../assets/js/bindings', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.fmt: cd .. && oxfmt -c page/.oxfmtrc.json page/src page/test assets/style.css
scripts.check: npm run build && tsc -p test/contract && oxlint --deny-warnings && cd .. && oxfmt -c page/.oxfmtrc.json --check page/src page/test assets/style.css
